name: @w6w-apps/beeminder
description: Track goals, log datapoints, manage pledges and charge yourself with Beeminder's commitment-contract goal tracker.

w6w.longDescription:
Beeminder is a goal tracker with teeth: each goal has a bright red line to stay on the right side of, and derailing costs a pledge you set in advance.

A workflow can read a user and their goals (active or archived), create and update goals, push data into a goal as a datapoint (single or batch, with a request id so a retried step never double-counts), edit or delete datapoints, and read them back with sorting and paging. It can also manage the commitment itself: ratchet a goal's safety buffer down, step the pledge down or cancel a scheduled step-down, short-circuit a pledge up, force an autodata refresh, call Uncle to derail a goal on purpose, or create an arbitrary charge.

The connection holds the personal auth token from beeminder.com/api/v1/auth_token.json (while logged in), sent as the `auth_token` query parameter by the sign hook. Note that Uncle, short-circuit and charge actions move real money and cannot be undone.
